parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 2 wheat for 1 brick. I have 1 wood and 2 wheat, so I don't have the brick he's looking for. It's interesting that he's reaching out to me for a trade after his alliance talk with Gemma. I need to keep an eye on his wheat production; he's swimming in it. My priority remains getting the robber off my ore (Hex 11) and finding a way to get brick/wood for my road building plan.
parsed.note_to_self: Jimmy is open to trading with me despite his deal with Gemma. I currently have 1 wood and 2 wheat. I need brick to progress.
